page.layout: One page of show-through only; no printed text on this side. The mirrored title block (top and centre) and the lower imprint are show-through from the reverse. A printer's device stands in the centre of the page.
page.notes: The page carries no text of its own. All the lettering is mirrored and inverted, which marks it as show-through from the other side of the leaf, so nothing is transcribed. Its visible content, read in mirror, is a title: "Jacobi Usserii Armachani De Reductione Episcopatus, ad formam regiminis Synodici, in antiqua Ecclesia recepti. Cum Notis Johannis Hoornbeek, S. Theologiae Professoris in Academia Lugduno-Batava." The imprint line at the foot is illegible in the scan. The central device (an ornamental printer's mark) is not transcribed, since it is not text.
